scientific_integrity: The six-root upper bound is analytic. The explicit attaining witness is supported by interval sign brackets and by the full primary-source multiscale construction; the prior lower bound and Abel formula are attributed. Bibliographic priority remains subject to external verification.
scientific_limitations: Exact six applies to simple roots of the first-order averaged radial displacement at regular finite radii, with two nonzero jumps away from the origin. It does not bound all finite-perturbation, grazing, sliding, higher-order or infinity-born cycles; the exact global two-jump maximum remains open.
title: Sharp six-root first-order cyclicity for two-jump Liénard perturbations
